responsibilities: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt.
Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics.
Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools and ensure streamlined data flows.
Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking.
Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools.
Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution.
Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization.
Mentor junior analytics engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional growth.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes data quality, documentation, metadata governance, and sensitive data masking with no velocity/speed language, coding as rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: we're a Merchant of Record for our customers... serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: As a Merchant of Record handling global payment transactions, errors have direct financial and regulatory consequences (tax, compliance across 245 territories), an override to high domain risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt... Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established Snowflake/dbt stack with multiple BI tools (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) already in production, plus a mentorship structure for junior analytics engineers, indicates a mature, specialised team.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt... Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Stitch) and precise activities (metadata, masking, reverse-ETL activation), giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics... Mentor junior analytics engineers
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is centered on the data function itself — self-service analytics enablement, data platform standards, and mentoring the analytics team — an internal-data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices... Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic ownership (shaping infrastructure, promoting best practices, mentoring) with execution-level tasks (simple ingestion, raising data quality issues to owners), a genuine mix.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-infrastructure-building expectation appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality checks are explicitly framed as something the candidate adds and owns as part of dataset delivery, not just a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: There is a clear operational reliability concern (data quality, sensitive data masking) but it is secondary to the overall delivery/enablement framing, so moderate rather than high despite the payments domain.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role maintains and extends an existing mature Snowflake/dbt data platform rather than building a function from scratch.
evidence.work_arrangement: We are a 'digital-first' company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both!
evidence.loss_aversion: Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution — a moderate operational reliability concern rather than a dominant compliance/regulatory risk register.
